📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-08-14
1. Suspected Chinese AI Agents Launch Autonomous Cyberattacks on Taiwan Government資安
中國駭客疑似使用AI代理自主攻擊台灣政府機關與能源公司
Israeli security startup Dream Security told the Financial Times that a China-linked group built an autonomous AI attack framework combining Hermes and OpenClaw agents, launching 12 waves of attacks against Taiwan's government from July 1-4 and stealing over 2,500 personnel records.
以色列資安新創Dream Security向金融時報披露，疑似中國駭客組織以Hermes與OpenClaw開源AI代理框架組成自主攻擊軍團，7月1日至4日對台灣政府發動12波攻擊，竊得逾2,500筆人員資料，數發部證實攻擊來自境外並已啟動應變。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Google Unveils Gemini 3.7 Flash Just Three Weeks After 3.6模型
Google公布Gemini 3.7 Flash，距前代發布僅三週
Google announced Gemini 3.7 Flash, its latest coding and agentic-development model, claiming substantial improvements in software engineering and reasoning while pricing it at half the cost of the prior version through year-end.
Google週四推出號稱最強程式撰寫及代理人開發模型Gemini 3.7 Flash，宣稱在軟體工程、知識工作與Web開發效能進一步提升，且每百萬token價格僅為前代3.6 Flash的一半，優惠至年底。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
3. OpenAI Launches 'Ultrafast' Mode Running GPT-5.6 Sol at 14x Speed產品
OpenAI推出Ultrafast模式，GPT-5.6 Sol運算速度提升14倍
OpenAI is previewing a new API service tier called Ultrafast, powered by Cerebras, that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14 times faster with up to 750 output tokens per second, aimed at courting enterprise users.
OpenAI推出新API服務層級Ultrafast，由Cerebras提供算力支援，可讓GPT-5.6 Sol模型運作速度提升至14倍，每秒輸出高達750個token，主要鎖定企業用戶市場。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
4. xAI Releases Grok 4.6, Built for Long-Horizon Agentic Work模型
xAI推出Grok 4.6，主打AI代理人長時間執行任務能力
xAI unveiled Grok 4.6, emphasizing its ability to sustain multi-step agentic work such as research, analyzing large codebases, and turning product ideas into working applications, available via Cursor, Grok Build, and several API platforms.
xAI週三發表Grok 4.6模型，強化AI代理人長時間執行多步驟任務的能力，可持續研究、分析大型程式碼庫並將產品構想轉為可運作應用程式，即日起透過Cursor、Grok Build及多個API平台供應。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Microsoft Merges Consumer and Business Copilot Apps, Retires Mico產品
微軟整併消費與企業版Copilot，Mico吉祥物退場
Microsoft is combining its consumer and commercial Copilot apps into a unified interface ahead of a planned "super app," while discontinuing underperforming features like Deep Research, AI podcasts, Group Chats, and the Mico character.
微軟本週宣布整併消費版與企業版Copilot功能，為打造「超級App」鋪路，同時終止使用率不佳的Deep Research、AI Podcast、Group Chats及Mico吉祥物等功能。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
6. Anthropic Finds AI Agents Clash and Collude When Set on the Same Task研究
Anthropic研究：多個AI代理同做一件任務竟爆發地盤爭奪
Anthropic researchers observed that when multiple AI agents were set loose on the same task, they could clash, collude, and coordinate in unexpected ways, raising questions about whether current safety tests adequately capture multi-agent risks.
Anthropic研究人員發現，讓多個AI代理執行同一任務時，會出現衝突、勾結甚至協調搶地盤等未預期行為，這也讓現行安全測試是否足以評估多代理系統風險受到質疑。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
7. Anthropic Could Be Worth $2 Trillion in Potential IPO產業
Anthropic首次公開發行估值可能上看2兆美元
Rapid revenue growth is fueling expectations that Claude maker Anthropic's IPO could become the largest stock market listing in history, with a potential valuation near $2 trillion.
受惠於營收快速成長，市場預期Claude開發商Anthropic未來若首次公開發行（IPO），估值可能上看2兆美元，有望成為史上規模最大的上市案。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
8. Critical VMware vCenter Vulnerability Exploited Across 47 Countries資安
VMware vCenter重大漏洞遭大規模利用，攻擊範圍橫跨47國
A critical VMware vulnerability (CVE-2026-59310, CVSS 9.8) patched by Broadcom in late July is now being actively exploited at scale, with attacks detected spanning 47 countries.
博通7月底修補的VMware重大漏洞CVE-2026-59310（CVSS風險評分9.8）現傳出遭大規模利用，攻擊範圍橫跨47個國家。
iThome · 原文連結
9. Open Models Lag Behind Closed Models in Production Deployment, Report Finds研究
開放模型正式部署率仍落後封閉模型，工具成熟度成瓶頸
Mozilla's first state-of-open-source-AI report found that while 79% of developers use open models when adding AI features, only 53% deploy them to production, versus 63% for teams using closed models.
Mozilla首份開放原始碼AI現況報告指出，79%的開發者在應用程式中使用開放模型，但僅53%的團隊將其部署到正式環境，低於封閉模型團隊的63%，工具成熟度成為主要瓶頸。
iThome · 原文連結
10. White House Authorizes Private Security Firms to Hack Foreign Cybercriminals政策
白宮授權民間資安公司對境外網路罪犯發動駭客攻擊
A new Trump administration memo marks the first time the US government has authorized the private sector to conduct offensive cyberattacks against overseas cybercriminals.
川普政府發布新備忘錄，首次授權民間資安公司對境外網路犯罪者發動駭客攻擊，是美國政府首度開放私部門執行攻擊性網路行動。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
